Thanks for reaching out and for the kind words about my React work. I’m interested in this analytics dashboard project and the scope you described (real-time charts, REST API integration, auth/role-based access, responsive design, dark mode) aligns well with my experience.

Would you be available for a call this week or early next week? If so, suggest a few time slots and I’ll confirm.

Thanks — looking forward to discussing this further.

Jordan Mitchell
ML Engineer
